name: Bruton Educational Trust Scholarship
summary: Yearly scholarship for financially disadvantaged commencing undergraduates who did the HSC at a rural or regional school.
key: $10,000 p.a. (course duration), for up to five years of full-time study.
who: Commencing the first semester of an undergraduate degree at the University of Sydney
Completed the HSC at a high school more than 100km from the University of Sydney or ANU
catches: Must maintain a Semester Average Mark of 65
2026 round opened 10 April 2026 and closed 9 October 2026
